report.summary: All three failures are the same 5-second page.goto('/books') timeout, and the cause is the app, not the tests. list_books() in app/main.py:150 sleeps a random 0 to 8 seconds on every books-page render, so whether the load finishes inside the 5 s limit is a coin toss. Fix the app's artificial random delay first (or make it deterministic for tests), then rerun the UI suite to confirm the failures go away.

causes.title: Books page render sleeps a random 0-8 s, so Page.goto times out intermittently
causes.explanation: list_books() calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) before querying the database. render_books() calls list_books() while rendering /books, so the HTML response is delayed by up to 8 s. The UI fixture sets the default timeout to 5000 ms (tests/ui/conftest.py:7), and BooksPage.open() calls page.goto('/books') with the default 'load' wait (tests/support/pages.py:34). Any render that sleeps longer than about 5 s makes goto raise TimeoutError. Roughly 3 of 8 s of the range exceed the limit, so about 37 percent of page loads fail. That fits this run: 3 of the 4 tests in test_books_ui.py that open /books failed, and test_deleted_book_disappears passed. The same code can pass on a rerun, so this is flaky, not a product bug. The sleep is artificial, since nothing in the app is supposed to take that long (per the comment in conftest.py:6). The outcome depends on random chance inside the app, which makes it flaky under the triage rules.
evidence: app/main.py:256: "books": list_books(user["id"]),  (called from render_books, used by GET /books)
tests/ui/conftest.py:6-7: "Nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s..." / page.set_default_timeout(5000)
E   playwright._impl._errors.TimeoutError: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. / navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:49185/books", waiting until "load"
test_deleted_book_disappears also opens /books and is not in the failure list, which suggests the random delay (not a broken page) is the cause
Limitation: the run logs do not include the actual render durations, so the timing mechanism is inferred from the code and the failure pattern.
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the random sleep from list_books() in app/main.py:150, or gate it behind an env var that tests never set. If the delay is meant to simulate slowness, make it a fixed, documented value, and have UI tests wait for the books list rather than the page 'load' event. Also consider raising the goto timeout for the UI suite. Then rerun the ui suite several times to confirm it is stable.
